sources.entry: ITFlow - Client IT documentation, ticketing, invoicing and accounting for MSPs (Managed Service Providers). (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: ITFlow is a free, open-source PHP platform combining client IT documentation, ticket management, quotes/invoicing and accounting for small managed service providers (MSPs).
summary.what_it_does: ITFlow stores client documentation including assets, contacts, domains, docs/files, passwords and tickets. It covers billing with quotes, invoices and expenses, and offers Stripe integration for online payments. It provides alerting for domain and SSL expiry and renewals. A client portal lets clients manage their own quotes, invoices and tickets. The README describes it as one platform in place of separate documentation, ticketing and billing tools.
use_cases: Document client IT assets, contacts and passwords
Track support tickets for MSP clients
Create quotes and invoices for managed services
Monitor domain and SSL certificate expiry
Give clients a self-service portal for tickets and invoices
how_to_run: Other manual installation methods are described in the project docs
notable: Combines documentation, ticketing, billing and accounting in one self-hosted app
Client portal for self-service quotes, invoices and tickets
Tracks its own roadmap via TaskFlow
caveats: Community pull requests are temporarily paused
README advises careful judgement before storing highly confidential information
Managed hosting is listed as coming soon and not yet available
Recommended install path is the Ubuntu/Debian script; other platforms need the manual docs
